sources.content: The fallowmere-collector image receives distributed traces and writes them to storage. It is built on ubuntu:24.04 and runs as the non-root user fallow with user ID 1500. It accepts OTLP over gRPC on port 4317 and OTLP over HTTP on port 4318. A web UI for browsing traces is served on port 16700. Spans are stored under /data, which should be a mounted volume. The entrypoint is /usr/local/bin/fallowmere. Both OTLP receivers accept gzip-compressed payloads.

FALLOWMERE_RETENTION sets how long traces are kept and defaults to 72h. FALLOWMERE_SAMPLE_RATE sets the fraction of traces kept, from 0 to 1, and defaults to 1, which keeps every trace. Set FALLOWMERE_UI_ENABLED to false to turn off the web UI. The health check calls /health on port 13133 every 30 seconds. The image writes its own logs to standard error in logfmt. Set FALLOWMERE_LOG_LEVEL to debug to see every rejected span; it defaults to info.
